newsitem.title: UK: American Express units set $3.0 bln EMTN programme.
newsitem.headline: American Express units set $3.0 bln EMTN programme.

text.p: American Express Co said in a statement on Thursday four of its subsidiaries signed multi-currency Euro medium-term note programmes for a total of $3.0 billion.

American Express Travel Related Service Co Inc (TRS), American Express Credit Corp (Credco), American Express Overseas Credit Corp Ltd (AEOCC) and American Express Bank Ltd (AEB) signed a programme for the issuance of long-term unsubordinated debt, it said.
Debt issued by TRS, Credco and AEOCC will by rated Aa3 by Moody's Investor Services and A-plus by Standard & Poor's, and AEV debt A2 and A-plus respectively.
Morgan Stanley & Co International is the arranger.
Debt will be issued only in bearer and form and will be subject to U.S. tax law requirements, the statement said.
